glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for morning, but today at 13:49 it was at desk_b1 (I guessed desk_o1). The "desk_o1 in morning" rule is unreliable; glasses often move to bedroom_1 (desk_b1 or nightstand_b1) during mid-day breaks or when Dana leaves the office. Do not default to desk_o1 after 12:00; check desk_b1 and nightstand_b1 first.

mug_dana: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for work hours, but today at 08:03 it was at kitchen_table_k1 and at 13:49 it was at sink_k1 (I guessed desk_o1 both times). The "desk_o1 during work" heuristic is consistently wrong for mugs. Mugs are frequently at kitchen_table_k1 in the early morning (pre-09:00) and at sink_k1 during mid-day (12:00-15:00) for cleaning or refilling. Check kitchen_table_k1 before 09:00 and sink_k1 during mid-day.

water_bottle_dana: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but today at 13:50 it was at sink_k1 (I guessed desk_o1). The "desk_o1 during work" heuristic is unreliable for water bottles in the afternoon. By 13:00, bottles are often at sink_k1 for refilling. Check sink_k1 for water bottles between 12:00 and 17:00. Do not default to desk_o1 during mid-day.

glass_dana: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but today at 12:22 it was at kitchen_table_k1 (I guessed desk_o1). The "desk_o1 during work" heuristic is unreliable for drinking glasses in the early afternoon. Glasses are often at kitchen_table_k1 during lunch breaks (12:00-14:00). Check kitchen_table_k1 for glasses between 12:00 and 14:00.

General Pattern: The "desk_o1 as central hub" heuristic is unreliable for all of Dana’s drinkware (mugs, glasses, water bottles) during mid-day (12:00-15:00) and early morning (pre-09:00). During these times, items frequently move to kitchen_table_k1 (breaks/eating) or sink_k1 (refilling/cleaning). Always adjust location based on specific time-of-day transitions rather than broad "workday" labels. Check kitchen spots first for mid-day and early morning queries.
